duration.value: instantaneous; 1 minute DESCRIPTION You channel energy into your hand and the next time you throw a weapon with that hand (be it an improvised weapon, a small throwing weapon or other weapon for the purpose of dealing damage) it increases in size once it leaves your hand and flies further. The item’s range increment increases by 5 feet per ninja level and it deals one additional damage die. This ninjutsu lasts for 1 minute or until a single item is thrown and then this ninjutsu is discharged.
